thought.text: Ada halaman **`/docs/configuration/model/`** dan **`multiple-models`**. Itu yang kamu butuhkan. Saya baca keduanya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && for p in model multiple-models; do echo "########## /docs/configuration/$p/ ##########"; curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://lightvela.ai/docs/configuration/$p/" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
s=re.sub(r'<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6]|/tr)>','\n',s)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s))
t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
print(t[:2500])
"; done
